paper_title: AutoRG：一种大小模型协同的自动报告生成框架
caption: 人为评估投票结果
model_annotation: The pie chart displays the results of human evaluations, comparing two categories. The chart is divided into two slices, representing AutoRG and 半模版式. The AutoRG slice is colored light blue and accounts for 64.77% of the chart, while the 半模版式 slice is colored red and accounts for 35.23%. A legend in the upper right corner confirms the color coding for each category. The slices are arranged with AutoRG occupying the larger portion on the right and 半模版式 on the left. No additional visual emphasis or labeling is applied to the slices beyond the percentage values and color coding.
